verdict.rationale: Paychex states it offers comprehensive health insurance benefits that can be added without switching systems or moving data. Its developer use cases include 'Benefit Administration: Recurring Deduction', which points to benefit deductions flowing into payroll. Enrollment administration itself is not documented, and the deduction sync appears only as a use-case title. Missing for 10: documented health-plan enrollment workflows for ops users, detail on how deductions sync automatically to payroll, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer and administer health insurance with enrollments and deductions synced to payroll

citations.quote: Offer 401(k) and comprehensive health insurance benefits.
Add benefits, time tracking, or HR tools when you need them, without switching systems, moving data, or retraining your team.
